m6ControlledActivation.head: b23dfc0eb1eb07ad3fd85fe89399c7fb5e40c5c0
m6ControlledActivation.contract: controlled straight/right/left production crossings are default-off, preserve fixed pool and stable token/slot, report zero teleports, survive camera movement during connector crossing, and leave default laneAuthority authored-local-lanes

nextTask.goal: Add lightweight deterministic connector reservation/yielding so conflicting route tokens wait before a junction, while tokens already inside normally clear it; integrate first with controlled route activation only.
actions: Implement a pure deterministic junction reservation registry keyed by compiler junction/conflict authority; do not use world-space steering or presentation geometry.
A token must reserve before entering a connector; if a conflicting reservation exists, keep it on the incoming lane and report a yield/wait state.
Once a token is inside its reserved connector, do not voluntarily stop it mid-connector; release the reservation on connector exit.
Release reservations on controlled stop/forced teardown and provide bounded stale-reservation expiry/recovery.
Start with a conservative same-junction conflict policy; do not overbuild lane conflict polygons unless production evidence requires them.
Add pure tests for deterministic ownership, same-token reentry, conflicts, release, stale expiry and no deadlock.
Integrate the registry only into M6 controlled route stepping and add a controlled multi-token/browser or deterministic integration scenario if the existing single-token API must be extended.
Keep default civilian traffic route activation disabled throughout M7.
acceptance: conflicting tokens cannot simultaneously enter the same reserved junction authority
waiting happens before connector entry, not mid-connector
same token retains reservation while crossing and releases it on exit
stale reservations recover within a bounded deterministic timeout
no infinite reservation deadlock in tests
controlled visible crossing remains teleport-free and fixed-pool
doNotAdvanceIf: reservation requires free steering or macro coordinates
a car must stop voluntarily in the middle of a connector to avoid conflict
a vanished token can hold a junction indefinitely
default civilian traffic starts consuming route reservation state before M8
